messages:
Jordan: Hey team — quick one from a new hire. Where should I post these during week 1? 
- hardware/keyboard/monitor requests
- repo/access asks
- questions that might need follow-ups (reviews, infra stuff)
- opting out of noisy bot pings

Tara (People Ops): Welcome Jordan! :tada: For hardware, please file in #help (there's a hardware form pinned). It's fine to ask quick follow-ups here tho. For access, ping #eng-infra or use the access form: https://redwood.example.com/access.

Alex: +1 to Tara. For repo access, include the repo name and your GH handle. If you need sudo/VMs, mention exact machine. For bot noise: you can mute channels via channel settings or DM BuildBot and run `/mute` for specific bots.

Chen: Heads-up on etiquette: keep technical threads threaded (use reply). If you post logs, paste small excerpt and a gist link — please avoid huge dumps. Use #eng-reviews for PR review asks so it doesn't get lost in onboarding chat.

Jordan: Thanks! How do I opt out of build-failure alerts specifically? They spam my phone.

BuildBot: To change build alert prefs: DM me `mute project:<project-name>` to mute a project, or run `/buildbot prefs` to see options. Note: muting rolls up to your user settings, not team-wide.

Tara (People Ops): If you want to reduce mobile pings quickly: in Slack -> Channel -> Notifications -> Nothing. You can also set Do Not Disturb (DND) hours in your profile.

Jordan: Perfect. One more: should I ask manager-level questions here or DM my manager?

Alex: Manager/1:1 stuff = DM your manager or People Ops. Save the channel for team-visible stuff like status updates or infra blockers.

Tara (People Ops): Also, to opt into onboarding reminders (checklists, docs), DM @OnboardBot with `subscribe onboarding` and it'll post check-ins in your DMs.

Jordan: Great, will do. Quick checklist I took away: 1) hardware -> #help (form) 2) access -> #eng-infra + access form 3) infra/PRs -> thread or #eng-reviews 4) bot prefs -> DM BuildBot or OnboardBot for onboarding messages 5) reduce pings via channel notif settings. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Chen: welcome again — feel free to @ me if you hit an infra snag, happy to help.

Tara (People Ops): Tag us if anything missing, and we'll update the onboarding doc with any gaps.
